card.name: Maracatu
card.tagline: Pernambuco Afro-Brazilian procession; nacao and rural forms.
card.profile: Maracatu denotes several performance genres of Pernambuco. Maracatu nacao (de baque virado, 'turned-around beat') is an Afro-Brazilian processional genre of Recife/Olinda rooted in the coronations of the Reis do Congo, featuring a royal court (king, queen, dama do paco carrying the calunga doll), a percussion group of 80-100 (alfaias, gongue, tarol, ganzas) and Candomble/Jurema ties. Maracatu rural (de baque solto), from the sugarcane Zona da Mata, is Afro-Indigenous, centered on the caboclo de lanca (English Wikipedia; IPHAN).
card.insight: IPHAN registered Maracatu Nacao as Patrimonio Cultural do Brasil in 2014; the oldest continuously active rural group dates to the late 19th/early 20th century (English Wikipedia; IPHAN).
